G4900.def: from «4862» and «1643»; to drive together, i.e. (figuratively) exhort (to reconciliation):--+ set at one again.

G4901.def: from «4862» and «1957»; to testify further jointly, i.e. unite in adding evidence:--also bear witness.

G4902.et: middle voice from (4862) and a primary hepo (to follow)
G4902.def: middle voice from «4862» and a primary hepo (to follow); to attend (travel) in company with:--accompany.

G4903.def: from «4904»; to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate:--help (work) with, work(-er) together.

G4904.et: from a presumed compound of (4862) and the base of (2041)
G4904.def: from a presumed compound of «4862» and the base of «2041»; a co-laborer, i.e. coadjutor:--companion in labour, (fellow-)helper(-labourer, -worker), labourer together with, workfellow.

G4905.def: from «4862» and «2064»; to convene, depart in company with, associate with, or (specially), cohabit (conjugally):--accompany, assemble (with), come (together), come (company, go) with, resort.

G4906.def: from «4862» and «2068» (including its alternate); to take food in company with:--eat with.

G4907.def: from «4920»; a mental putting together, i.e. intelligence or (concretely) the intellect:--knowledge, understanding.

G4908.def: from «4920»; mentally put (or putting) together, i.e. sagacious:--prudent. Compare «5429».

G4909.def: from «4862» and «2106»; to think well of in common, i.e. assent to, feel gratified with:--allow, assent, be pleased, have pleasure.

G4910.et: from (4862) and a derivative of a presumed compound of (2095) and a derivative of (2192) (meaning to be in good condition, i.e. [by implication] to fare well, or feast)
G4910.def: from «4862» and a derivative of a presumed compound of «2095» and a derivative of «2192» (meaning to be in good condition, i.e. (by implication) to fare well, or feast); to entertain sumptuously in company with, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to revel together:--feast with.

G4911.def: from «4862» and «2186»; to stand up together, i.e. to resist (or assault) jointly:--rise up together.

G4912.def: from «4862» and «2192»; to hold together, i.e. to compress (the ears, with a crowd or siege) or arrest (a prisoner); figuratively, to compel, perplex, afflict, preoccupy:--constrain, hold, keep in, press, lie sick of, stop, be in a strait, straiten, be taken with, throng.

G4913.et: middle voice from (4862) and the base of (2237)
G4913.def: middle voice from «4862» and the base of «2237»; to rejoice in with oneself, i.e. feel satisfaction concerning:--delight.

G4914.def: from a compound of «4862» and «2239»; mutual habituation, i.e. usage:--custom.

G4915.def: from «4862» and a derivative of «2244»; a co-aged person, i.e. alike in years:--equal.

G4916.def: from «4862» and «2290»; to inter in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate spiritually (to Christ by a sepulture as to sin):--bury with.

G4917.def: from «4862» and thlao (to crush); to dash together, i.e. shatter:--break.

G4918.def: from «4862» and «2346»; to compress, i.e. crowd on all sides:--throng.

G4919.def: from «4862» and thrupto (to crumble); to crush together, i.e. (figuratively) to dispirit:--break.

G4920.def: from «4862» and hiemi (to send); to put together, i.e. (mentally) to comprehend; by implication, to act piously:-- consider, understand, be wise.

G4921.def: from «4862» and «2476» (including its collateral forms); to set together, i.e. (by implication) to introduce (favorably), or (figuratively) to exhibit; intransitively, to stand near, or (figuratively) to constitute:--approve, commend, consist, make, stand (with).

G4922.def: from «4862» and «3593»; to travel in company with:--journey with.

G4923.def: from a compound of «4862» and «3598» ("synod"); companionship on a journey, i.e. (by implication), a caravan:--company.

G4924.def: from «4862» and «3611»; to reside together (as a family):--dwell together.

G4925.def: from «4862» and «3618»; to construct, i.e. (passively) to compose (in company with other Christians, figuratively):--build together.

G4926.def: from «4862» and «3656»; to converse mutually:--talk with.

G4927.et: from (4862) and a derivative of a compound of the base of (3674) and the base of (3725)
G4927.def: from «4862» and a derivative of a compound of the base of 3674 and the base of «3725»; to border together, i.e. adjoin:--join hard.

G4929.def: from «4862» and «5021»; to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct:--appoint.

G4930.def: from «4931»; entire completion, i.e. consummation (of a dispensation):--end.

G4931.def: from «4862» and «5055»; to complete entirely; generally, to execute (literally or figuratively):--end, finish, fulfil, make.

G4932.def: from «4862» and the base of «5114»; to contract by cutting, i.e. (figuratively) do concisely (speedily):--(cut) short.

G4933.def: from «4862» and «5083»; to keep closely together, i.e. (by implication) to conserve (from ruin); mentally, to remember (and obey):--keep, observe, preserve.

G4934.def: middle voice from «4862» and «5087»; to place jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to consent (bargain, stipulate), concur:--agree, assent, covenant.

G4935.def: adverb from a derivative of «4932»; concisely (briefly):--a few words.

G4936.def: from «4862» and «5143» (including its alternate); to rush together (hastily assemble) or headlong (figuratively):--run (together, with).

G4937.def: from «4862» and the base of «5147»; to crush completely, i.e. to shatter (literally or figuratively):--break (in pieces), broken to shivers (+ -hearted), bruise.

G4938.def: from «4937»; concussion or utter fracture (properly, concretely), i.e. complete ruin:--destruction.

G4939.def: from «4862» and «5162» (in a passive sense); a fellow-nursling, i.e. comrade:--brought up with.

G4940.def: from «4862» and «5177»; to chance together, i.e. meet with (reach):--come at.

G4941.def: from «4940»; an accident; Syntyche, a Christian female:--Syntyche.

G4942.def: from «4862» and «5271»; to act hypocritically in concert with:--dissemble with.

G4943.et: from (4862) and a derivative of a compound of (5259) and the base of (2041)
G4943.def: from «4862» and a derivative of a compound of «5259» and the base of «2041»; to be a co-auxiliary, i.e. assist:--help together.

G4944.def: from «4862» and «5605»; to have (parturition) pangs in company (concert, simultaneously) with, i.e. (figuratively) to sympathize (in expectation of relief from suffering):--travail in pain together.

G4945.def: from a compound of «4862» and «3660»; a swearing together, i.e. (by implication) a plot:--comspiracy.

G4946.def: plural of uncertain derivation; Syracuse, the capital of Sicily:--Syracuse.

G4947.def: probably of Hebrew origin («06865»); Syria (i.e. Tsyria or Tyre), a region of Asia:--Syria.

G4948.def: from the same as «4947»; a Syran (i.e. probably Tyrian), a native of Syria:--Syrian.

G4949.et: from a compound of (4948) and the same as (5403)
G4949.def: feminine of a compound of «4948» and the same as «5403»; a Syro-phoenician woman, i.e. a female native of Phoenicia in Syria:--Syrophenician.

G4950.def: from «4951»; a shoal (from the sand drawn thither by the waves), i.e. the Syrtis Major or great bay on the north coast of Africa:--quicksands.

G4951.pos:
1. to draw, drag
    1. of one before the judge, to prison, to punishment
G4951.def: probably akin to «138»; to trail:--drag, draw, hale.

G4952.def: from «4862» and «4682»; to rend completely, i.e. (by analogy) to convulse violently:--throw down.

G4953.et: from a compound of (4862) and the base of (4591)
G4953.def: neuter of a compound of «4862» and the base of «4591»; a sign in common, i.e. preconcerted signal:--token.

G4954.def: from «4862» and «4983»; of a joint body, i.e. (figuratively) a fellow-member of the Christian community:--of the same body.

G4955.et: from a compound of (4862) and a derivative of (4714)
G4955.def: from a compound of «4862» and a derivative of «4714»; a fellow-insurgent:--make insurrection with.

G4956.def: from a derivative of «4921»; introductory, i.e. recommendatory:--of commendation.

G4957.def: from «4862» and «4717»; to impale in company with (literally or figuratively):--crucify with.

G4958.def: from «4862» and «4724»; to send (draw) together, i.e. enwrap (enshroud a corpse for burial), contract (an interval):-- short, wind up.

G4959.def: from «4862» and «4727»; to moan jointly, i.e. (figuratively) experience a common calamity:--groan together.

G4960.def: from «4862» and «4748»; to file together (as soldiers in ranks), i.e. (figuratively) to correspond to:--answer to.

G4961.def: from «4862» and «4757»; a co-campaigner, i.e. (figuratively) an associate in Christian toil:--fellowsoldier.

G4962.def: from «4862» and «4762»; to twist together, i.e. collect (a bundle, a crowd):--gather.

G4963.def: from «4962»; a twisting together, i.e. (figuratively) a secret coalition, riotous crowd:--+ band together, concourse.

G4964.def: from «4862» and a derivative of «4976»; to fashion alike, i.e. conform to the same pattern (figuratively):--conform to, fashion self according to.

G4965.def: of Hebrew origin («07941»); Sychar (i.e. Shekar), a place in Palestine:--Sychar.

G4966.def: of Hebrew origin («07927»); Sychem (i.e. Shekem), the name of a Canaanite and of a place in Palestine:--Sychem.

G4967.def: from «4969»; butchery (of animals for food or sacrifice, or (figuratively) of men (destruction)):--slaughter.

G4968.def: neuter of a derivative of «4967»; a victim (in sacrifice):--slain beast.

G4969.def: a primary verb; to butcher (especially an animal for food or in sacrifice) or (generally) to slaughter, or (specially), to maim (violently):--kill, slay, wound.

G4970.et: neuter plural of sphodros (violent, of uncertain derivation) as adverb
G4970.def: neuter plural of sphodros (violent; of uncertain derivation) as adverb; vehemently, i.e. in a high degree, much:-- exceeding(-ly), greatly, sore, very.

G4971.def: adverb from the same as «4970»; very much:--exceedingly.

G4972.def: from «4973»; to stamp (with a signet or private mark) for security or preservation (literally or figuratively); by implication, to keep secret, to attest:--(set a, set to) seal up, stop.

G4973.def: probably strengthened from «5420»; a signet (as fencing in or protecting from misappropriation); by implication, the stamp impressed (as a mark of privacy, or genuineness), literally or figuratively:--seal.

G4974.et: from a presumed derivative probably of the same as sphaira (a ball, "sphere", cf the feminine sphura, a hammer)
G4974.def: neuter of a presumed derivative probably of the same as sphaira (a ball, "sphere"; compare the feminine sphura, a hammer); the ankle (as globular):--ancle bone.

G4975.et: neuter of a presumed derivative of the alternate of (2192) as adverb
G4975.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the alternate of «2192» as adverb; nigh, i.e. nearly:--almost.

G4976.def: from the alternate of «2192»; a figure (as a mode or circumstance), i.e. (by implication) external condition:--fashion.

G4977.def: apparently a primary verb; to split or sever (literally or figuratively):--break, divide, open, rend, make a rent.

G4978.def: from «4977»; a split or gap ("schism"), literally or figuratively:--division, rent, schism.

G4979.et: diminutive of schoinos (a rush or flag-plant, of uncertain derivation)
G4979.def: diminutive of schoinos (a rush or flag-plant; of uncertain derivation); a rushlet, i.e. grass-withe or tie (generally):--small cord, rope.

G4980.def: from «4981»; to take a holiday, i.e. be at leisure for (by implication, devote oneself wholly to); figuratively, to be vacant (of a house):--empty, give self.

G4981.et: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of (2192)
G4981.def: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of «2192»; properly, loitering (as a withholding of oneself from work) or leisure, i.e. (by implication) a "school" (as vacation from physical employment):--school.

G4982.et: from a primary sos (contraction for obsolete saoz, "safe")
G4982.def: from a primary sos (contraction for obsolete saos, "safe"); to save, i.e. deliver or protect (literally or figuratively):--heal, preserve, save (self), do well, be (make) whole.

G4983.def: from «4982»; the body (as a sound whole), used in a very wide application, literally or figuratively:--bodily, body, slave.

G4986.def: from the base of «4982» and «3962»; of a safe father; Sopatrus, a Christian:--Sopater. Compare «4989».

G4987.def: from another form of «4673»; to pile up (literally or figuratively):--heap, load.

G4988.et: from the base of (4982) and that of (4599)
G4988.def: from the base of «4982» and that of «4599»; of safe strength; Sosthenes, a Christian:--Sosthenes.

G4990.def: from «4982»; a deliverer, i.e. God or Christ:--saviour.

G4991.et: feminine of a derivative of (4990) as (properly, abstract) noun
G4991.def: feminine of a derivative of «4990» as (properly, abstract) noun; rescue or safety (physically or morally):--deliver, health, salvation, save, saving.

G4992.et: neuter of the same as (4991) as (properly, concretely) noun
G4992.def: neuter of the same as «4991» as (properly, concretely) noun; defender or (by implication) defence:--salvation.

G4993.def: from «4998»; to be of sound mind, i.e. sane, (figuratively) moderate:--be in right mind, be sober (minded), soberly.

G4994.def: from «4998»; to make of sound mind, i.e. (figuratively) to discipline or correct:--teach to be sober.

G4996.def: adverb from «4998»; with sound mind, i.e. moderately:--soberly.

G4997.def: from «4998»; soundness of mind, i.e. (literally) sanity or (figuratively) self-control:--soberness, sobriety.

G4998.et: from the base of (4982) and that of (5424)
G4998.def: from the base of «4982» and that of «5424»; safe (sound) in mind, i.e. self-controlled (moderate as to opinion or passion):--discreet, sober, temperate.

G4999.def: plural of Latin origin; huts or wooden-walled buildings; Tabernoe:--taverns.
